title: Live-Einbruchversuch und Experten-Tipps: Polizei Berlin zeigt wirksame Sicherungstechnik am Tag des Einbruchschutzes am 25. Oktober 2026

extraction.summaryEn: Berlin police and the tischler guild invite the public to a burglary-prevention day at police headquarters on 25 October 2026, featuring a live break-in demonstration. The event runs from 12 to 16 noon and is not an incident.
